title: Stuthulaku Pathruda
lyrics:
[Verse]
Stuthulaku pathruda stotrarhuda
Sthuthiyimpa tarama na valla
Sthuthiyimpa tarama na valla

[Chorus]
Deva na deva
Sthotramul sthotramul
Deva na deva
Sthotramul sthotramul

title: Sthuthiyu Mahimayu
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Sthuthiyu mahimayu neeke prabhuva
Ellappudu memu paadedamu

[Verse]
Neevu chesina melulakai
Ninnu sthuthiyinchi paadedamu

title: Naa Pranamaina
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Naa pranamaina na yeasayya
Naa gundeloni oopiri neevayya

[Verse]
Ninnu vidichi nenu undalenu
Nee prema leni bhrathukoddu

title: Nee Krupa Leni
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Nee krupa leni kshanamu
Nenu brathukalenu
Nee preama leni jeevitham
Nenu oohinchanu

[Verse]
Adavilo nenu thappipoyina
Thalli la nannu ethukunnavu

title: Aashrayam
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Aashrayam neevayya
Naa aashrayam neevayya

[Verse]
Naa konda naa kota naa rakshaka
Neeve naa devudavu

title: Yesunatha
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Yesunatha sthothram
Naa yesunatha sthothram

[Verse]
Nannu preminchi naakai pranamicchi
Rakshinchinavanduku sthothram

title: Neeve Naa Sangeethamu
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Neeve naa sangeethamu
Neeve naa praanama
Neeve naa sarvamu

[Verse]
Kastallo nannu aadarinchinavu
Kanneeru thudichinavu

title: Andhakaramulo
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Andhakaramulo aladuchunna nannu
Veluguloki nadipinchinavu

[Verse]
Naa jeevithamantha neeke ankitam
Neeke sthothramu

title: Raju Neeve
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Raju neeve prabhuva
Naa raju neeve prabhuva

[Verse]
Nee rajyam ravalani
Nee chitham jaragalani

title: Preminchedan
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Preminchedan adhikaamuga
Ninnu preminchedan adhikaamuga

[Verse]
Neevu chesina upakaaramul
Nenu maruvanu

title: Vandanamu
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Vandanamu vandanamu
Yesayya neeke vandanamu

[Verse]
Neevu maa koraku paatlu paddavu
Vandanamu vandanamu

title: Sthothram
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Sthothram chellinthumu
Sthuthi sthothram chellinthumu

[Verse]
Deva neeve maaku aashrayam
Sthothram chellinthumu

title: Nee Prema
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Nee prema naa paina
Entho goppadi

[Verse]
Nenu paapini ayinanu
Nannu preminchithivi

title: Anandame
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Anandame paramanandame
Yesayya sannidhilo anandame

[Verse]
Naa paapalu kshaminchinavu
Naaku shanthi nichchinavu

title: Neeve Naa Aadharam
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Neeve naa aadharam
Neeve naa aashrayam

[Verse]
Naa jeevithamulo neeve prabhuva
Neeve naa sarvamu

title: Raju Neeve Prabhuva
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Raju neeve prabhuva
Naa raju neeve prabhuva
Nee rajyam ravalani
Nee chitham jaragalani

[Chorus]
Neeke mahima neeke sthothram
Neeke mahima neeke sthothram

[Verse 2]
Neevu chesina melulakai
Ninnu sthuthiyinchi paadedamu

title: Vandanamu Vandanamu
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Vandanamu vandanamu
Yesayya neeke vandanamu

[Verse]
Neevu maa koraku paatlu paddavu
Vandanamu vandanamu

title: Parishuddhudavu
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Parishuddhudavu neevayya
Parama pithavu neevayya

[Verse]
Deva neeve maaku aashrayam
Sthothram chellinthumu
